messages.subject: Re: How can I run this scrip on remote Hadoop server?
parts: All rmr2 documents cover your case. rmr2 will use whatever configuration of Hadoop you have on your machine. If it's for a distributed cluster, that's how hadoop jobs will run, if it's pseudo-distributed or standalone, same story. rmr2 honors those settings. Therefore, you need to consult documentation for your hadoop distribution and modify the settings to your satisfaction.
